useWhen: You need to set prices for your product

workflow.description: Understand what customers are willing to pay
Validate with A/B tests or surveys

examples.input: A B2B SaaS project management tool with free, basic, and pro plans
examples.output:
## Pricing Strategy: Project Management SaaS

### Value-Based Pricing

**Customer Value:**
- Save 5 hours/week on project management
- Average hourly rate: $50
- Weekly value: $250/month
- Should capture 10-20% = $25-50/month

---

### Competitor Research

| Competitor | Price | Features |
|-----------|-------|----------|
| Asana | $24.99/user | Full-featured |
| Monday | $19/user | Visual, good UX |
| Trello | $17.50/user | Kanban focus |
| Notion | $10/user | All-in-one |

**Insight:** Market ranges $10-25/user. We need differentiation.

---

### Pricing Tiers

| Feature | Free | Basic | Pro |
|---------|------|-------|------|
| Price | $0 | $15/user | $35/user |
| Users | 3 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Projects | 3 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Storage | 500MB | 10GB | Unlimited |
| Features | Basic | + Gantt + Timeline | + AI + Priority |
| Support | Community | Email | Priority |

---

### Psychology Tactics

- **Anchor:** Show enterprise at $99 to make Pro look cheap
- **Tier Names:** Free, Basic, Pro (not Starter, Standard, Plus)
- **Annual Discount:** 20% off (standard in market)
- **Free Trial:** 14 days (enough to see value)


---

### Projected Revenue

| Year | Users | ARPU | MRR |
|------|-------|------|-----|
| 1 | 1,000 | $25 | $25,000 |
| 2 | 5,000 | $28 | $140,000 |
| 3 | 15,000 | $30 | $450,000 |

---

### Test Plan

1. Survey: "Is $35/month fair?" with alternatives
2. A/B test: $35 vs $39 to find optimal
3. Survey: Feature preferences for tier differentiation
